conducted into this affair; if so, the details
thereof?

Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to

State of Chhattisgarh?

Cross-border terrorism
*327. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
SHRI N.K. PREMA-

Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased

CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES

developing hydrogen as an energy source;
and
(c) the estimated cost of doing this?
Fencing of Rajouri-Poonch sector
*330.  SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether 280 kilometres Line of
Control in the woods of Rajouri-Poonch
sector has been fenced; and

96
(b) if not, when the work is likely to be
taken up and completed to stop infiltration
of Pak ultras into India?

DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Karnataka has anti-terrorist

situation in the State; and

whether Government propose to give any
direction to set up such cell in the State?
Nirmal Gram Puraskar scheme
†*332. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched
an incentive scheme named as "Nirmal
Gram Puraskar" with a view to encourage
cleanliness in rural areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of rural areas estimated
to be benefited by the above scheme?
Funds under APDRP to Assam
*333. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds sanctioned  to
Government of Assam under Accelerated
Power Development and Reforms
Programme for power generation,
transmission and distribution during the last
three years;
(b) the reasons for gap  between the
sanctioned  amount and released amount;
and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Textile Reconstruction Fund
*334. DR. A.R. KIDWAI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether top officials from the
Ministries of Finance, Textiles and a few
leading financial institutions and Nationalised
banks met in New Delhi recently to discuss
ways to revive the debt-ridden textile mills

discussed and decisions taken; and
(c) how the decisions are being
implemented?

State Governments under this scheme in
May, 2003 and the amount contributed by
the State Governments for the scheme;
(c) the amount spent for 'Test Check'
and whether any complaints of misuse of

the funds allocated under this scheme were
received; and
(d) whether any outlines were drawn
for the implementation of the scheme

*336. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
fence India-Myanmar border;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the target for completion of the
project?
Arms license in Delhi
*337. SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
90 per cent of crimes in Delhi are committed
using unlicensed guns and illegal fire arms;
(b) if so, the estimated number of
unlicensed guns in Delhi;
(c) how many licensed persons of guns/
revolvers are registered with the DCP
(Licensing) as on 1st July, 2003; and
(d) whether Government propose to
restrict the issue of armed license in future
on account of an increase in crime rate and
if not, the reasons therefor?
Revival of small and medium sector
textile units
*338. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plans to offer
some special package over what has already
been allocated in the Union Budget
2003-2004 to revive small and medium
sector textile units;
(b) if  so, the details of the package
Government intends to offer to the textile
sector to revive small and medium units;
(c) whether such a package would be
worked out for bigger units also in the future;
and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

SINGH 'LALAN':
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether textiles industry has a major
share in total exports of the country;
(b) if so, the percentage of textiles in the
total exports during 2000-01, 2001-02 and
2002-03; and
(c) the measures being taken by
Government to increase this percentage of
export in the coming years?
Shrinking of glaciers
†*340. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry are aware of
the fact that glaciers of many snow rivers
are shrinking in the country;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

shrinking;
(c) whether Government propose to
formulate any special scheme for
conservation of originating sites of snow
rivers under water conservation scheme of
rivers including Ganga-Yamuna as well as
for conservation of catchment areas of
tributaries of these rivers; and
(d) if not, the alternative steps proposed
to be taken to raise water level in these
rivers?
